  PROBLEM: The pre-existing dirty-path overlap guard computes a baseline with `git diff --binary HEAD -- "${rb_fix_preexisting_literals[@]}"` and re-computes the same command after the writer runs, but this does not detect index-only changes.
  WHY: A review-blocked writer can do `git add -u .` without modifying the working tree, the comparison passes, and the staged overlapping change enters the commit.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh: verify_review_scope_guard_integrity function body (around lines 21-32) and its only call site (around line 2071) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The function returns 1 with the same `::error::Refusing [judge-fix] commit: generated-advisory scope validator changed after the writer ran.` message for an empty or malformed `REVIEW_SCOPE_GUARD_EXPECTED_SHA256`, a missing or unreadable `files_touched_scope_guard.py`, and a real digest mismatch.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell whether the expected digest was not published, the staging helper is missing, or the writer tampered with the scope guard.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh: Tightened digest-check block (around lines 2531-2537) and the unified error path at line 2548 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Invalid expected or actual digests, digest inequality, missing scope guard files, and a generated-advisory scope violation all funnel into the same error path.
  WHY: Operators cannot distinguish missing input, a tampered validator, or a real scope violation from the single log line.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh: Location: Baseline capture at line 1867 and post-writer comparison at lines 1991-2001 | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=3
  PROBLEM: The snapshot only captures `git diff HEAD`, so a writer that stages pre-existing paths via any command that ignores the `:(exclude,literal)` pathspecs slips past the guard.
  WHY: `git diff --cached HEAD` would also miss unstaged edits, so neither alone is sufficient; both staged and unstaged diffs must be compared.
  Suggested minimal fix: Capture both `git diff --binary HEAD -- "${rb_fix_preexisting_literals[@]}"` and `git diff --binary --cached HEAD -- "${rb_fix_preexisting_literals[@]}"` as the baseline, and compare both diffs after the writer; exit 1 if either differs.
